requirements.title: Security and Compliance
requirements.description: A set of features that ensure the security and compliance of user data, including biometric login, device binding, location-based security, and travel notifications.

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: Features related to system performance, such as backend concurrent sessions, investment order routing, and notification service throughput.

requirements.title: Account Opening and Verification
requirements.description: Digital account opening with identity verification via Onfido and Onfido KYC integration.

requirements.title: Investment and Savings Management
requirements.description: Investment portfolio, goal-based savings, and other savings features, including investment management tools.

requirements.title: Card Management
requirements.description: A process that allows users to manage their debit cards, including freezing and unfreezing their cards, viewing their card details, and accessing their card information.

requirements.title: Multi-Region Deployment
requirements.description: Multi-region AWS deployment for high availability.

requirements.title: Active-Passive Failover
requirements.description: Active-passive failover configuration for quick recovery from outages.

requirements.title: Data Partitioning and Archival
requirements.description: Data partitioning by month and archival to warm storage.

requirements.title: Real-time Balance Maintenance
requirements.description: Real-time balance maintenance with materialized views and daily reconciliation.

requirements.title: Data Management
requirements.description: Account data model, user data model with encryption, goal-based savings data model, and other data management features.

requirements.title: Notification and Alerts
requirements.description: Push notification delivery latency, real-time login alerts, and recurring transaction detection with bill prediction alerts.

requirements.title: App Performance and Compatibility
requirements.description: App launch performance, Android minimum version, and other performance and compatibility features.

requirements.title: Apex Clearing Brokerage Integration
requirements.description: Integration with Apex Clearing for brokerage services.

requirements.title: Request Money
requirements.description: Feature to request money from other users with customizable messages.

requirements.title: Merchant Logo and Location Display
requirements.description: Display of merchant logos and locations on transaction details.

requirements.title: Tax Document Generation
requirements.description: Generation of tax documents for users.

requirements.title: No Minimum Balance or Monthly Fees
requirements.description: No minimum balance or monthly fees for savings accounts.

requirements.title: Payment and Account Integration Services
requirements.description: Services for integrating payments and accounts, including Plaid Bank Account Linking with Micro-Deposits Verification and FedNow Payment Settlement with Instant P2P Settlements.

requirements.title: User Interface
requirements.description: Screens for tracking budget and expenses, rewards program details, card management, user profile and account management, home dashboard and quick actions.

requirements.title: Transaction Management
requirements.description: Processes for sending money, requesting money, paying bills, buying fractional stock or ETF, and splitting bills with groups.

requirements.title: Budgeting and Savings
requirements.description: A feature that allows users to set savings goals, track their progress, and receive notifications when they reach their goals, as well as automatically round up their purchases to the nearest dollar and deposit the amount into their savings account.
